name: Bilgeri Camping
beschreibung: Bilgeri Camping is a welcoming campsite located in Tyrol, catering perfectly to holidaymakers travelling with campervans, caravans, or tents. The grounds provide dedicated pitches equipped with convenient electricity and water connections. Well-maintained sanitary facilities are available on-site. The scenic surroundings in Tyrol invite guests to explore a wealth of outdoor pursuits, including hiking and cycling tours. Thoughtful amenities such as a fresh morning bread delivery service enhance the holiday experience. The campsite is open seasonally.
